story: An icon of the skies, the Oriental Turtle Dove (Anthracoceros albirostris) is a species from the Bucerotidae family. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Oriental Turtle Dove is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Oriental Turtle Dove helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife.
